_comment: Kali Linux signature security tools (curated starter set). Kali ships 600+ tools; this covers the well-known ones. The scanner adds every other tool actually installed on the loaded Kali image, and its /help picks up their descriptions from whatis/man where available.
nmap: Network scanner — discover hosts, ports and services.
netcat: Read/write raw TCP/UDP connections (the 'nc' swiss-army knife).
tcpdump: Capture and inspect network packets from the terminal.
aircrack-ng: Wi-Fi security auditing / WPA key cracking suite.
airmon-ng: Put wireless cards into monitor mode.
hydra: Fast online password brute-forcer for many protocols.
john: John the Ripper — offline password hash cracker.
gobuster: Brute-force URIs, DNS subdomains and vhosts.
hping3: Custom TCP/IP packet crafting and probing.
crackmapexec: Swiss-army knife for pentesting Windows/AD networks.
